node.title: Re: Grab Current Line of SVG File
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Could you show a short but representative input file and the output you expect for that input?

In general, I would very strongly recommend you [id://1201438|don't parse XML with regexes], it's extremely brittle. I recommend a proper XML parser such as [mod://XML::LibXML], it will make you much happier in the long run.
